rule.title: A nonrecourse debt canceled in a foreclosure or abandonment is not canceled-debt income

citation.line: Sales or Other Dispositions (Such as Foreclosures and Repossessions) — Nonrecourse debt
citation.wording: If you owned property that was subject to a nonrecourse debt in excess of the FMV of the property, the lender’s foreclosure on the property doesn’t result in ordinary income from the cancellation of debt.
